messages:
jordan: Quick sync after the postmortem readout — root cause: simultaneous cross-region failover + low DNS TTLs causing a retry storm and transient TLS handshakes. Need owners for DNS change, routing jitter, synth probes, and TLS backoff.

liam: Agree. Can someone take registrar coordination? Last time registrar limits made rollouts messy.

kai: I can own routing-side mitigation (jitter + cooldown). Will sketch an approach and PR. ETA: proto in staging 48h.

netops: I'll take registrar + DNS TTLs. Proposal: increase edge record TTL from 20s -> 90s and add per-region healthhint records. Will open registrar ticket. Target: Fri EOD.

jordan: Please include rollback steps in the ticket (how to revert TTL quickly) and an ops runbook entry.

netops: Adding snippet to postmortem doc now:
```
# DNS proposed change
record: api.redwood.net
previous_ttl: 20
proposed_ttl: 90
notes: reduce query amplification during cross-region failover; validate registrar propagation
rollback: set ttl back to 20 and invalidate cache via CDN purge if needed
```

sre-oncall: I'll add a dual-region synthetic probe (probe-dualregion-rrc) and a dashboard tile for retries/min + successful handshakes. Alert: retries/min > 2x baseline for 5m -> page oncall. Canary start: tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

qa: I'll run a staged chaos job that simulates region flaps against staging with the routing-jitter flag disabled/enabled and capture retry histograms. Test harness name: chaos-failover-v2.

kai: Implementation notes: add randomized failover delay per instance in routing controller (seeded jitter 0-8s) and a per-cluster failover cooldown of 30s. Feature flag: routing.jitter.enabled. PR #721 created: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/721.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: triggered staging-deploy for PR #721 (kai). status: queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

liam: TLS side: we saw increased handshake retries against fallback regions. Action: exponential backoff on TLS handshakes in client lib (max retries=3, backoff base=200ms). Who pairs on this?

netops: I'll pair with kai on handshake backoff and cert-cache validation on edge proxies. We suspect cert cache miss TTLs caused extra connections.

jordan: Ownership recap, confirm please:
- DNS TTL + registrar -> netops (target Fri EOD)
- Routing jitter + cooldown -> kai (staging proto 48h, canary next week)
- Dual-region probe + alerts -> sre-oncall (canary 09:00 UTC tomorrow)
- TLS handshake backoff + proxy cert-cache check -> netops + kai (sync tomorrow)
- Chaos/regression tests -> qa (start after staging deploy)

netops: Confirmed. I filed registrar ticket REG-210 and DNS PR #704 and added an emergency rollback runbook entry.

sre-oncall: I'll add gating rules: probe green + canary metrics: retries delta < 10% and handshake error rate < 1% before prod rollout. If breached -> rollback flag and page.

qa: Once PR #721 deploys to staging I'll run chaos-failover-v2 and post results in the doc. Expected runtime ~2h.

kai: I'll include test vectors and a small harness in the PR to validate jitter distribution and cooldown effectiveness. Also adding a fail-safe feature flag to immediately disable jitter across clusters.

ops-bot: reminder: staging-deploy PR #721 started at 1721235800, est finish 1721236060.

jordan: Last item: recurrence plan. Ops asked for a 6-week watch of cross-region retry rates with weekly triage. Tag: "rrc-monitor". I'll create a recurring invite and own the first three weeks.

liam: I'll take weeks 4-6. Adding the saved query to the ops-runbook now.

netops: Pushed DNS PR #704 and added registrar contact info (REG-210). Will update the postmortem with exact timestamps for the planned TTL change.

sre-oncall: Probe created: probe-dualregion-rrc. Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/d/probe-dualregion-rrc (will publish after canary).

jordan: OK no objections. Action items in the postmortem: owners + PR links + timeboxed check-ins. We won't release to prod until probes are green and canary shows metrics within the gating thresholds. Marking this thread as action-tracker. :white_check_mark:

kai: Thanks all, I'll post the PR link and staging results once deploy finishes.

qa: Will update test results and attach artifacts to the postmortem doc.

ops-bot: note: if probe-dualregion-rrc triggers page, escalation path: oncall -> netops -> infra-lead.

jordan: Thanks team. Please update the doc with check-ins and close when PRs + probe pass.
